thinking_docs.name: Gemini API thinking docs (discrete levels)
thinking_docs.purpose: Authoritative source for Gemini's reasoning surface: the unified discrete thinking-level table (low/medium/high) spanning BOTH the 3.x and 2.5 model generations. As of 2026-06 Google retired the separate numeric 2.5 thinkingBudget table — 2.5 now uses the same discrete levels — so this tracker no longer parses numeric budgets or the 0/-1 sentinels. ai.google.dev moved this page to client-side rendering on 2026-11-02, so its HTML carries no table; the .md.txt copy does, and update/extract_gemini_thinking.py parses that. Robustness: the must_contain_all anchors are the literal column headers of the level table (Model | Default Thinking | Levels Supported). If Google restructures the table or the copy, those anchors are absent from the fetched bytes and the gate fails LOUD (the extractor exits 4) instead of silently scraping an empty shell. The docs-freshness cron hashes the EXTRACTED FACTS (canonical JSON), not the raw page, so re-renders / cosmetic churn never false-trigger an expensive Opus run. New Gemini level-table models are flagged from the snapshot's unexpected_models (this page is itself the model source for the reasoning matrix); the catalog cron owns model lists.
